name: Jammu

queries.query: जम्मू शहर सरकारी भू-अभिलेख GIS नक्शा खसरा जमीन के प्लॉट का मानचित्र जम्मू नगर निगम
queries.scope: Find an official, public full-geometry cadastral/parcel service for Jammu city and its land-record authority.
queries.result: Official search results identify Jammu Municipal Corporation’s GIS survey of residential/commercial properties, the city’s ward GIS-map downloads, and the J&K Revenue Department’s JK Land Records Information System. No anonymously queryable parcel-feature endpoint was identified; the land-record system’s current public shell is a secure sign-in workflow.
queries.executionMethod: Official Hindi/English search, municipal and state GIS page review, and read-only login-shell/bundle inspection. No account or property query.

queries.query: Jammu India official cadastral parcel polygon public GIS land records map municipal survey
queries.scope: Cross-check for a city-bound open parcel vector route and exact public layer capability.
queries.result: Official Jammu pages confirm Revenue land-record custodianship, JK LRIS GIS functions, a municipal GIS property survey, and ward-map downloads. Ward boundaries, planning maps, and authenticated land-record workflows are not full public parcel geometry; none returned a parcel polygon.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only public page/app-shell inspection.

portals.name: JK Land Records Information System (JKLR)
portals.operator: Revenue Department, Government of Jammu and Kashmir
portals.observation: The official state system is described as a secure GIS-based land-record service for public and agency users; the delivered app shell uses credential/CAPTCHA/OTP sign-in. No sign-in, protected API call, or property lookup was attempted.

portals.name: Jammu Municipal Corporation GIS property survey
portals.observation: JMC publishes a GIS survey notice for residential/commercial properties; this confirms a city-specific property GIS activity but not an open parcel layer.

portals.name: My Jammu GIS Map
portals.operator: Jammu Municipal Corporation / Jammu Smart City Limited
portals.observation: Public city portal lists ward-level GIS map downloads. Ward maps are administrative/geographic products and do not establish parcel boundaries or native parcel IDs.

requests.observation: Official JKLR app shell loads a secure sign-in workflow; no protected data was requested.
JMC public notices page includes GIS Survey of Residential Commercial Properties.
Official city portal lists ward-map downloads; no parcel geometry response is exposed on the page.
State GIS map is a BharatMaps multi-layer thematic/base map; its described layers are administrative/transport/terrain, not cadastral parcels.

source.name: JK Land Records Information System and Jammu Municipal GIS property survey
source.operator: J&K Revenue Department; Jammu Municipal Corporation
source.serviceType: GIS-based land-record and urban-property systems; public app shell is sign-in based and no open parcel vector endpoint was verified.
source.layer: JKLR parcel layer not publicly accessible without sign-in; JMC public GIS page lists ward maps, not parcels.
source.nativeIdEvidence: No parcel feature response or schema was obtained; no account-bound service was queried.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: JK Revenue maintains land records and JKLR is GIS-based; Jammu Municipal Corporation has a current residential/commercial GIS survey and a city ward-map page.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous full parcel polygons at the WUP point or within Jammu city were verified. Ward and master-plan maps are not parcel geometry.

technicalBlocker: The GIS-based land-record app presents a secure sign-in workflow; the public municipal GIS material found is ward-level and no anonymous parcel vector query was exposed.
remainingUncertainty: Whether post-auth JKLR or JMC internal systems contain complete urban parcels is unknown; no authenticated, personal, or parcel-specific access was attempted.
nextStep: Revisit only if an official open full-parcel geometry endpoint or explicitly public download is published.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No anonymous full parcel geometry was verified for this city.

registryBasis: Jammu district Revenue Department identifies itself as custodian of land records and survey/settlement; Government of India’s service listing describes JKLR as GIS-based; JMC separately advertises a city residential/commercial GIS survey.
scopeLimits: Do not treat ward or zoning polygons as cadastral parcels.
No credentials, owner names, phone/address searches, taxes, or property-specific queries were used.
